item.title: LOT-171: MP and group MP lists (setting, switch)
item.body:
LOT-171
Closes #297
Claim: cloud/lot-171

**Problem.** Group MPs drown in one-to-one ones; operator decision 2026-10-28 asks for an optional split.

**What changed.** New setting `mp_list_display` (`MPListDisplay`, default "Tout en un", unknown reads default) with a Réglages picker; `MessageListModel` filters the page by `isGroup` when "Deux listes", per-segment unread counts (page-bounded), a bounded (5 pages) forward search so a segment never shows "empty" while later pages exist; group rows show replies and pages. Spec: `docs/lots/LOT-171-mp-lists.md` (legacy pointers, which topic features apply to MPs). The reply composer for MPs stays LOT-128's (`composer: nil` unchanged).

**Tests.** `MessageListSplitTests` (default unchanged, switch, counts, search, bound, last page, failure, back never searches, setting read on appear), `GeneralSettingsModelTests`, `MPListDisplayKeyTests`. HFRKit tests and SwiftLint `--strict` pass locally; the app target is built by CI only.

## Mac check needed
For `mac/m2-lead`:
- [ ] "Deux listes" on a real mailbox: both segments, unread counts, switch persists across tab changes.
- [ ] Segment search on a real multi-page mailbox: no flash of "empty", bound of 5 pages acceptable.
- [ ] Group row "N réponses · M pages" matches the thread (the MP list reply count is not verified against a capture).
- [ ] Light, dark, Dynamic Type XL; iPhone 18 Pro and iPad (switch placement under the toolbar, sidebar).
- [ ] Opening a group thread from the "MP multiples" segment lands on its latest message.

---

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added an optional split view for private messages, separating one-to-one and group conversations, with unread counts for each segment.
  * Added a setting to switch between a single combined list and split lists. The combined list remains the default.
  * Selecting an empty segment can automatically search up to five later pages for conversations.
  * Group conversations now show participant, reply, and page details.
* **Documentation**
  * Documented the display options and split-list behavior.

Tests cover switch visibility and selection behavior.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes **Change:** Feature **Possibly related issues** - [ezzz/HFRnow#379](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379): Records the decision to include optional two-list MP display; this change implements that display option. - [ezzz/HFRnow#324](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/324): Lists LOT-171’s MP list setting and switch as a deliverable; this change adds those features. - [ezzz/HFRnow#447](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/447): Requests app wiring for the synced settings store; this change passes the store to the message-list model for reading the new preference. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#307](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/307): Adds the paged private-message list extended here with segments, unread counts, and bounded searches. - [ezzz/HFRnow#19](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/19): Adds `PrivateMessageThread.isGroup`, which this change uses for segment filtering and unread counts. **Suggested labels:** `type: lot`
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to f73bf

No confirmed issue blocks merging; complete the planned mailbox and visual checks.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to f73bf

The inspected changes retain existing account access checks and limit each automatic search. No new access-control weakness was established, but cancellation and cross-device behavior have not been fully verified. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The newly exercised scope is additional mailbox-list pages under the active account's existing authority. Each automatic scan permits at most five additional page loads; this is a per-scan bound, not a global limit across repeated interactions. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Every scan page passes through the existing login check and private-message fetcher, whose default identity is authenticated. Segment selection changes presentation and page traversal, not the account or credentials used for requests. - _observed_ — After a confirmed send, automatic selection is restricted to exactly one subject match in the authenticated page-1 reload. Split mode changes to that returned row's segment before selecting it; ambiguous matches do not select a conversation. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — Search tokens, load counters, and the shared loader's generation check prevent superseded completions from replacing current list state or applying stale load follow-up. Hidden selections are cleared when segments change. These controls contain stale UI state even though physical cancellation of underlying work was not independently established.

**Explanation** [`#297`] The setting, split control, page-local unread counts, client-side filtering, group-row counts, shared reader, feature spec, and model tests support the issue. Three coding requirements remain unmet. Group rows do not show participant names; the spec confirms the omission. Group threads cannot be answered through LOT-128: the spec and PR description state that MessageReaderColumn still receives composer: nil. The incremental diff was unavailable, but the reviewed head's spec and view support these findings. **Resolution** Show group participants in rows. ** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Keep the sent-message result on its matching segment.** If the member sends a one-to-one MP while “MP multiples” is selected, `newMessageDidClose` reloads page 1 through this automatic search. The search can move past the newly sent row before the subject match runs. If page 1 also contains a group row, the match can instead select the new MP while `visibleThreads` hides it. Suppress advancement for the post-send reload, then select the matching row’s segment before opening it.

`@francoisgn` The synchronous change prevents an older task from restoring an older segment. One search-order case remains: 1. The first queued search starts loading a page for the latest segment. 2. The second search increments `searchCount`, then exits because `loader.isLoading` is true. 3. When the page load finishes, the first search exits because its token is stale. If that page has no matching rows, later pages are not searched. Please tie search ownership to the selection change or coalesce the queued searches. A regression test can pause the first page load, start the second search, and check that a match on a later page is reached.
